llm-agent.pseudocode:
def run_agent(goal, llm, tools, max_steps=10):
    history = [('user', goal)]
    for _ in range(max_steps):
        step = llm.decide(history, tools.specs())
        if step.kind == 'final':  # 목표 달성
            return step.answer
        if not policy_allows(step.tool, step.args):
            history.append(('error', '권한 없음'))  # 최소권한
            continue
        if step.tool in HIGH_RISK and not human_ok(step):
            history.append(('error', '승인 거부'))  # 사람 승인
            continue
        obs = sandbox_call(tools, step.tool, step.args)
        history.append(('observation', obs))  # 관찰 반영
    return '최대 단계 초과로 중단'  # 무한 루프 방지
